text:
margot: Heads up — noticed invoice spikes for a handful of EU customers after last night's routing rollout. billing shows ~2x tokens for some requests.

sanjay: Ugh. Which route/variant? any correlation with fallback behavior?

margot: Looks like requests routed to primary model (redwood-large) that hit capacity and then fell back to redwood-mini. Meter shows tokens for both the initial attempt and the fallback.

jen: Do we intentionally emit billing events on aborted attempts? I thought we only count final accepted response.

raul: We used to dedupe by fingerprint (request_id + route) but the new routing proxy changed the fingerprint to include node_id to help debugging. That probably broke dedupe.

billing-bot: ALERT: invoice-aggregator detected >25% token delta for tenant acme-eu between ingestion window 2026-03-18T02:00Z and 2026-03-18T03:00Z. Sample events attached: `evt_az123`, `evt_az124`.

sanjay: can you paste a minimal example log for one of the doubled traces? quick grep from proxy logs should do.

margot: paste from proxy logs:
```
2026-03-18T02:12:03Z INFO request_id=rx-7f42 route=generate_v2 node_id=proxy-12 -> routed to redwood-large
2026-03-18T02:12:03Z WARN request_id=rx-7f42 route=generate_v2 node_id=proxy-12 -> fallback to redwood-mini (capacity)
2026-03-18T02:12:04Z INFO billing_event: request_id=rx-7f42 model=redwood-large tokens=432
2026-03-18T02:12:04Z INFO billing_event: request_id=rx-7f42 model=redwood-mini tokens=421
```

jen: Looks like both billing events emitted with same request_id but different route fingerprint because proxy appended `|proxy-12` to route_id in the fallback path.

raul: yep — the aggregation layer groups events by route_id at ingest time. If route_id differs we treat as distinct consumption and don't dedupe.

margot: immediate mitigation idea: update aggregation to normalize route_id by stripping node suffix OR rekey dedupe by (tenant_id, request_id) instead of full route_id. Thoughts?

sanjay: prefer fixing fingerprint upstream in proxy to not mutate the canonical route id. Aggregation changes are more invasive and risk subtle regressions.

jen: agree with sanjay. Quick patch in proxy to stop appending node_id to route fingerprint for billing path. But we still want node_id for debug logs — make it a separate field `diagnostic_node` not part of `route_id`.

raul: +1. We should also add a short-term backfill/de-dup job for the ingestion window to correct counts. Otherwise invoices already went out with inflated numbers for that hour.

margot: I'll open a PagerDuty for finance ops so billing team knows and can hold invoice CSVs. Also adding a console dashboard alert for sudden token deltas by tenant.

billing-bot: NOTE: queued retraction request created: retraction_id=rt-20260318-01 tenant=acme-eu window=2026-03-18T02:00Z-03:00Z

jen: PR drafted: proxy change that separates `route_id` and `diagnostic.node`. Rolling out to canary now.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: canary/proxy v2.14.3 -> proxies in us-west-2 (2 instances). Watch /metrics: `billing_events_emitted_total` and `route_fingerprint_changes`.

sanjay: I'll kick off a small backfill: run dedupe job keyed by (tenant_id, request_id) for the 02:00–03:00Z window and produce a delta report.

margot: Thanks — once we have delta we should signal finance and create corrected invoice artifacts. Also add a regression test that asserts billing events per request <= 1 unless explicit retry flag set.

raul: follow-ups: (1) add integration test for proxy to ensure `route_id` immutability, (2) add an ingestion-side assertion that emits metric `ingest.duplicate_event_detected` when duplicate events with same (tenant,request) arrive in same window.

jen: Will pair with infra QA tomorrow morning to run high-load fallback scenario and validate counts.

margot: OK. Summary of action items:
- jen: patch proxy to separate debug node field (PR open)
- sanjay: backfill/dedupe job + delta report
- raul: ingestion metric and short-term aggregation normalization guard
- margot: notify finance, hold CSVs, add console alert
- jen + qa: integration test & load validation

margot: Thanks all. We'll update this thread as new deltas come in. :thumbsup:
